checkedAlternates.risk: Smell and taste are both chemical senses.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The olfactory bulb processes smell (group-1), whereas papillae on the tongue house taste buds (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Semicircular canals detect head rotation rather than sound.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Together with the cochlea, they form the inner-ear mechanosensory labyrinth (group-4).
